text:
The canvas holds:
add-payee-details — Serves seq 12 (scope: a personal customer, in-app, paying a new UK sort code and account number, once, now) and seq 7 (customer must complete payee creation alone, in-app) — this is the entry screen where the customer types the new payee's details.
confirm-payee-result — Serves seq 6 (the agent's undocumented "close match" explanation step, now surfaced for the customer to read themselves) and seq 7/seq 23 (customer must resolve a non-match Confirmation of Payee result unaided, and cannot skip the check) — shows the name-check result and requires the customer to confirm or go back before proceeding.
choose-account-and-amount — Serves seq 6 (the undocumented balance-check step before the first payment, so a short account doesn't cause a failed retry) and seq 23/seq 11 (the first-payment limit for new payees is enforced and stated up front) — lets the customer pick which account to pay from and enter the amount for this first payment to the new payee.

Next: the screen where the customer chooses the amount and sends the first payment.

input.why: Serves seq 8/seq 30 (the in-app scam intervention that must do the job the phone agent's ear did — a warning shown before the irrevocable Faster Payment is sent, with the customer's response captured) and seq 6 (the review surfaces every detail the agent would read back before sending) — the final screen before the payment leaves the account.

props.title: Before you send this payment
props.body: This payment can't be recalled once sent. If someone is asking you to pay urgently, or is on the phone guiding you through this, stop — that's a common sign of a scam.
props.dismissLabel: I need to stop and check
